key.name: transcription-provider
key.description: The provider used for automatic transcription, or disabled.

key.name: xai-base-url
key.description: The HTTP or HTTPS base URL used for xAI transcription requests.

key.name: deepgram-base-url
key.description: The HTTP or HTTPS base URL used for Deepgram transcription requests.

key.name: recordings-directory
key.description: An absolute directory path. An empty value uses ~/Recordings/Meetings.

key.name: post-transcribe-hook
key.description: An absolute executable path, or an empty value to disable the hook.

key.name: meeting-detection-reminder-enabled
key.description: Whether to show a reminder when browser meeting capture is detected.
